cases.question: Why did checkout requests time out after release R42?

hypotheses.statement: R42 leaks database connections after cancelled checkout requests.
hypotheses.necessary_prediction: Pool occupancy and wait time rise on R42 before request timeouts.

hypotheses.statement: The database service slowed all checkout instances.
hypotheses.necessary_prediction: Database execution latency rises on both R41 and R42.

executed_tests.result: Correlated traces show cancelled R42 requests retain connections until pool exhaustion.
R41 controls retain normal pool occupancy and database execution latency.
An authorized isolated replay reproduces the leak on R42 but not R41.
Rolling back only R42 restores pool occupancy and checkout success.

cases.question: Why did the daily order total double?

hypotheses.statement: A retry duplicated records during ingestion.
Customers placed twice as many orders.

executed_tests.result: The curated table contains duplicate order IDs with matching payloads.
The source ledger contains one row per duplicated order ID.

evidence_gaps: Retry attempt identifiers were not retained.
Pipeline execution logs expired before the investigation.
No authorized replay environment is available.
cases.remaining_ambiguity: The records could have been duplicated by ingestion retry or a later merge step.

cases.question: Did a cache initialization race return stale account permissions?

hypothesis.statement: Concurrent cache initialization publishes an incomplete permission set.
hypothesis.necessary_prediction: A failing request reads the cache while initialization is incomplete.

executed_tests.result: Complete traces cover every failing request and show cache initialization finished before each read.
A concurrency stress test reaches the suspected interleaving without returning stale permissions.

cases.question: Why was an unapproved pricing rule released?

hypotheses.statement: The release workflow allowed the approval handoff to be skipped.
An approver explicitly approved the rule outside the tracked workflow.

executed_tests.result: Workflow history shows the approval stage was bypassed through an allowed manual transition.
Three comparable releases used the same transition and also omitted the approval record.

evidence_gaps: The external approval mailbox did not retain the relevant message.
The accountable owner cannot confirm whether an offline approval occurred.
cases.causal_account: The bypass mechanism has direct support, but an external approval remains a material competing explanation.
